data.long_meaning: In Greek mythology, Myrta is the name of a nymph who presided over gardens and groves. The name Myrta comes from the Greek word 'myrto', meaning myrtle tree. Myrta was a popular name among the ancient Greeks and Romans, and it is believed to have been used as a symbol of love and fertility.
